en.window.title: lilOS — {name}
en.files.runnable: «{name}» is a program or a script: lilOS does not open it on the computer. Export it and open it yourself if you trust it.
en.files.tooBig: The file is too big to open on the computer (more than 512 MB).
en.files.noProgram: No program of the computer opens «{name}».
en.files.missing: The file is no longer on the computer.
en.files.pickFolder: Choose a folder of the computer
en.updates.available.title: lilOS {version} is available
en.updates.available.body: Click to download the new version of the program.
en.updates.ready.title: lilOS {version} is ready
en.updates.ready.body: It will be installed when you quit the program.
en.welcome.title: Welcome to lilOS
en.welcome.subtitle: Choose where it runs. You can add other servers later, from the Control Panel.
en.welcome.addSubtitle: Another lilOS to open with this program, each in its own window.
en.welcome.local.title: On this computer
en.welcome.local.text: The program installs and starts the kernel and the database: no Docker, no Node.js, no browser needed. Your data stay in
en.welcome.local.exists: lilOS already runs on this computer with this program.
en.welcome.local.noRuntime: This copy of the program does not carry lilOS (development: npm run runtime).
en.welcome.remote.title: Connect to a server
en.welcome.remote.text: A lilOS on another computer or at work. Sign in with your user of that server.
en.welcome.remote.trusted: I trust this server: it may open files on this computer and change the program's settings
en.welcome.existing.title: Use the lilOS already installed
en.welcome.existing.textVersion: lilOS {version} in {dir}, running at {url}. The program opens it as a server.
en.welcome.existing.text: A lilOS running at {url}. The program opens it as a server.
en.welcome.user.text: The first user of lilOS: an administrator. You will sign in with it.
en.welcome.user.name: User name
en.welcome.user.nameHint: 2–32 characters: lower-case letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.
en.welcome.error.url: Write the address of the server.
en.welcome.error.username: User name: 2–32 characters among lower-case letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore.
en.welcome.error.password: The password needs at least 8 characters.
en.welcome.error.noRuntime: This copy of the program does not carry lilOS.
en.welcome.error.notLilos: At {url} there is no lilOS answering.
en.status.starting.title: lilOS is starting
en.status.starting.text: The database and the kernel are starting on this computer.
en.status.failed.title: lilOS did not start
en.status.failed.text: The kernel of this computer stopped. Try again; if it fails again, the logs say why.
en.status.unreachable.title: The server does not answer
en.status.unreachable.text: {url} cannot be reached. Check the network, or choose another server.
en.status.crashed.title: The page of lilOS stopped
en.status.crashed.text: Something went wrong in the page. Load it again.
en.unload.title: Some changes are not saved yet
en.unload.text: lilOS is still sending them to the kernel. If you close now they may be lost.
